name: B10-0237/2025 (ECR) – Prosecution of journalists in Cameroon, notably the cases of Amadou Vamoulké, Kingsley Fomunyuy Njoka, Mancho Bibixy, Thomas Awah Junior, Tsi Conrad
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the prosecution of journalists in Cameroon, notably the cases of Amadou Vamoulké, Kingsley Fomunyuy Njoka, Mancho Bibixy, Thomas Awah Junior and Tsi Conrad
part_text:
The European Parliament is calling for the release of five jailed journalists in Cameroon: Amadou Vamoulké, Kingsley Fomunyuy Njoka, Mancho Bibixy, Thomas Awah Junior and Tsi Conrad. It says they were held on baseless charges. The Parliament condemns the lack of press freedom in Cameroon and asks the authorities to free all media workers held for doing their job, drop the charges, and scrap laws used to silence journalists. It also urges European Union countries to put diplomatic and economic pressure on Cameroon until they are freed.

- Nothing changes yet; this is the Parliament's demand, not a law.
- It concerns Cameroon's government and jailed journalists and media workers.
- European Union countries are asked to pressure Cameroon until releases happen.
